'''Primitive Vermin''' are a type of [[Mobs|Mob]], placed into the [[Primitive Parasites|Primitive]] Tier.

==''Spawning''==
* Spawns after a successful merging between 4 [[Moving Flesh]], through the [[Evolution System]].
* Spawned by [[Stage III Beckon|Stage III Beckons]].
* Spawned by 4 [[:Category:Assimilated Mobs|Assimilated Mobs]] stored into a [[Stage III Dispatcher|Stage III]] or [[Stage IV Dispatcher|IV Dispatcher]].
* Spawned by level 4 or higher [[Scent System|Scents]].

==''Behavior''==
Primitive Vermin are flying, bombarding, swarm summoning units, they will chase and hover above the player when attacking.

* Primitive Vermin hover above the player dropping [[Gnat|Gnats]].
** When the number of Gnats exceeds 20, they will drop bombs instead.
* Primitive Vermin have a chance of blocking incoming damage, nullifying it.
* In certain circumstances, Primitive Vermin can apply contact damage, though they make no effort to do so.
* Primitive Vermin can break blocks that have their [[Hardness]] Value up to 1, with a 60-tick cooldown and 1 block range.

===''Weaknesses''===
Primitive Vermin, like any other [[Mobs|Mob]], present a weakness to Fire. Damage inflicted by Fire is quadrupled.

=== ''Post Death'' ===
* On death, Primitive Vermin have a chance to explode, releasing [[Remains|Primitive Remains]] and an effect cloud of stacking Poison and [[Call Of The Hive|COTH]].
** If at least one [[Colony]] exists in the dimension, Primitive Vermin will become [[Moving Flesh]] upon death instead.
